profiles.evidence: Bench bring-up of a Freenove ESP32-S3-WROOM CAM (N16R8) on 2026-09-13/14: chip identified as ESP32-S3 rev 0.2 with 16 MiB flash and 8 MiB PSRAM, full flash backup MD5-verified, an ESP-IDF 5.5.5 image flashed over serial with hash verified, Wi-Fi joined at -63 dBm and an OTA update accepted (hardware/freenove/README.md and its logs). Sensor I2C is on GPIO47 (SDA) and GPIO21 (SCL) because GPIO8 and GPIO9 are camera data pins D2 and D1 on this board. ESTIMATED, NOT MEASURED: regulator efficiency, quiescent draw and the usable battery fraction - see docs/DEMO-ASSUMPTIONS.md.
